explication: Le firmware STM32 démarre dans main.ino, qui affiche un menu (menu.ino, buttonMenu.ino, graphics.ino) donnant accès aux modules BadUSB, infrarouge, RF et RFID. source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The STM32 firmware starts in main.ino, which displays a menu (menu.ino, buttonMenu.ino, graphics.ino) giving access to the BadUSB, infrared, RF and RFID modules. The modules save and reload their signals on the SD card via sdList.ino, and the PCB folder contains the hardware design.
